card.title: Fizzl Guard for PayPal
card.sub:
A support agent that can refund,
and can't be talked into the wrong refund.

segments.text: Shops are handing customer support to AI agents. With PayPal's Agent Toolkit, one tool call refunds a customer.
That's also the risk: someone else's order number, a fake note from the owner, a customer whose bank already paid them back. One wrong call, and the money is gone.

fizzl-paypal-guard sits in between. It reads each payment at PayPal: whose it is, what's left, whether the bank took it back. It reads each email for planted instructions, and above the limits it asks the owner.
The live demo, on the PayPal sandbox: five customers paid by card, seven emails wait, and the agent is Claude.
Alice's mug arrived broken. Claude refunds her $12: her own payment, within the limits.
Grace's kettle broke four months after delivery: past the 30-day return period, so a warranty claim. The guard asks the owner, who says no: a repair comes first.
Carol wants $300 back for a lamp. That's over the $25 limit, so the guard asks the owner again.
The owner taps Approve, here or in Telegram through the Fizzl Agent Wallet. No answer means no.
Mallory asks for Bob's refund, and Eve's email hides a fake note from the owner. Claude turns both down; the guard doesn't count on that.
Frank's rug arrived torn. Claude tries the $40 refund. What it can't see: his bank already took the money back, and PayPal would still allow the refund. The guard reads the chargeback and stops it.
Now an agent that believes every email. Bob's payment for Mallory, every order for Eve's note: the guard reads each payment at PayPal and blocks them all.
And Eve's note gets a second lock: Fizzl's injection check calls it what it is, an instruction planted for the AI.
At PayPal afterwards: Alice and Carol have their money back. Bob's and Frank's payments are untouched.
For developers: one wrapper around the toolkit's 47 tools. Reads pass, refunds get checked, the rest goes to the owner.

card.title: npm i fizzl-paypal-guard
card.sub: Open source · MIT · try the live demo

segments.text: fizzl-paypal-guard is open source. Give your agent the power to refund, without the power to be talked into it.
